warnings.rationale: The #734 and #735 parent migrations removed the lru and number_prefix warnings. LanceDB 0.31 / Lance 8, DataFusion 53, FastEmbed 5.17, and Candle 0.9 still select paste; removing every remaining path now requires coordinated parent changes or replacing the persistence and embedding stacks.
warnings.upstream_status: RustSec classifies RUSTSEC-2024-0436 as INFO/unmaintained and reports no patched paste version. It lists pastey and with_builtin_macros as alternatives, but transitive adoption requires changes in each owning parent stack.
warnings.impact_rationale: paste is a compile-time proc macro and is not linked into RNA's runtime. The advisory reports maintenance status rather than an exploitable vulnerability; the residual risk is future maintenance and supply-chain exposure. Cargo.lock pins 1.0.15, and the bidirectional gate rejects any new version, advisory, or undeclared warning.
review_triggers: any version, source, or feature change to one of the listed direct dependents or its owning LanceDB, DataFusion, Candle, tokenizers, image, FastEmbed, or metal-candle stack
a published parent graph removes all paste paths or adopts a maintained replacement
RUSTSEC-2024-0436 changes classification, gains a patched version, or paste receives another advisory
